_provenance: Per-item Preferences captured from a real PMS 1.43.4: the Setting list an item's own settings tab reads. A show has eleven, a season has three, and simplex previously invented a single episodeSort row. The movie list (3 settings) was captured the same way on 2026-09-12: GET /library/metadata/{id}?includePreferences=1 against plexlab 1.43.4. Cycle 15 corrected the show's `episodeSort` value from `0` to `-1`: the capture was taken from a show that had been written, and both references answer `-1` for a show that has not been (kids 1.43.4 show 6, zen 1.42.2 show 5189, re-read live). `-1` is the value that INHERITS the library setting, so the stale `0` read as a per-show refusal of it.
